channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Zelensky demands Trump explain new ceasefire proposal after Putin’s call with US president
item.description: Zelensky demands Trump explain new ceasefire proposal after Putin's call with him. Ukraine-Russia war latest: Zelensky demands Trump explain new ceasefire proposal after Putin’s call with US president The Independent.

item.title: Palestine FA chief hits out at Israel federation VP at FIFA Congress
item.description: Palestine FA chief criticized Israel federation VP at FIFA Congress in Canada. Palestine and Israel representatives had been lined up close together at the FIFA Congress in Canada. Palestine FA chief hits out at Israel federation VP at FIFA Congress.

item.title: 20,000 civilian sailors are stuck in the gulf that opens to the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: 20,000 civilian sailors are stuck near the Strait of Hormuz due to a blockade. Thousands of seafarers remain stuck as the Strait of Hormuz blockade continues. The United Nations urges for a plan to facilitate their release.

item.title: US gas reaches $4.30 per gallon; Trump says prices will drop after Iran war
item.description: US gas prices rose to $4.30 per gallon amid the Iran diplomatic deadlock. Price of petrol in US jumps by nearly 30 cents in one week amid Strait of Hormuz blockade and Iran diplomatic deadlock.

item.title: Palestinians mourn football loving teenager killed by Israeli army
item.description: Mourners in Hebron buried 16-year-old Ibrahim al-Khayatt shot by Israeli soldiers. Mourners in Hebron laid to rest 16-year-old Ibrahim al-Khayatt who was shot in the chest by Israeli soldiers. Palestinians mourn football loving teenager killed by Israeli army.

item.title: Hegseth testifies on Iran war before Senate committee: Key takeaways
item.description: The Pentagon chief testified on Iran war before a Senate committee for a second day. Pentagon chief testifies alongside top general for second day, in first public Congressional hearings since war began.

item.title: Israel’s ‘brutal attack’ will not deter us
item.description: Israel intercepted 22 boats carrying aid for Gaza near Crete and detained 175 activists. Activist Omer Aslan says Israel’s interception of 22 boats late Wednesday will not stop the Global Sumud Flotilla.

item.title: US House votes to end record shutdown over immigration enforcement
item.description: The US House voted to end the record shutdown, providing funding for most Department of Homeland Security agencies. The vote provides funding for most Department of Homeland Security agencies, except for two subagencies responsible for immigration enforcement.

item.title: Passengers pulled from water after learner driver crashes bus into major European river
item.description: A trainee bus driver crashed into the River Seine in Paris, and four people were rescued. Four people have been rescued from the River Seine in Paris after a trainee bus driver crashed through a barrier and into the water.

item.title: Israel intercepts Gaza flotilla near Crete and detains 175 activists
item.description: Israel detained 175 activists after intercepting 22 boats carrying aid for Gaza near the Greek island of Crete. Pro-Palestinian activists say 22 boats carrying aid for Gaza were illegally intercepted in international waters near the Greek island.

item.title: After Germany, Trump Says US Considering Reducing Troops In Italy, Spain
item.description: Trump said the US is considering reducing troops in Italy and Spain after criticizing Madrid's defense spending. Trump has also lambasted Madrid for failing to increase defense spending. After Germany, Trump Says US Considering Reducing Troops In Italy, Spain.

item.title: Iran won't be booted out of World Cup and will play in US, says FIFA boss
item.description: FIFA boss says Iran will compete at the World Cup and play in the US. The head of FIFA has said Iran will still compete at the World Cup and play matches in the US because "we have to unite".

item.title: Deadly Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon despite ceasefire
item.description: Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon killed at least nine people, including two children. At least nine people - including two children - were killed, according to Lebanon's health ministry. Deadly Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon despite ceasefire.

item.title: We call upon North Korea to return to compliance with its international obligations
item.description: France urged North Korea to comply with its international obligations. We call upon North Korea to return to compliance with its international obligations France ONU.

item.title: Kosovo to hold snap elections in June
item.description: Kosovo will hold snap elections in June due to a political deadlock over president election. Kosovo will soon hold its third parliamentary election in a year and a half. Prime Minister Albin Kurti was able to form a government in February, but now there's a political deadlock over who shoud be elected president.

item.title: Iranians Live With Pain and Powerlessness, Beneath a Smooth Veneer
item.description: Iranian citizens are attempting to rebuild their lives after months of upheaval, but many are struggling with grief, economic stress, and a loss of hope. The country's veneer of stability hides underlying pain and powerlessness.

item.title: US Alerts on Chinese and Russian Space Threats in Global Security
item.description: The US has alerted on Chinese and Russian space threats to global security. The warning highlights potential dangers from the two nations' space capabilities. US Alerts on Chinese and Russian Space Threats in Global Security India News Network.

item.title: US-Israel-Iran Ceasefire Live Updates: Trump Floats New Plan Aimed At Creating Maritime Alliance To
item.description: US President Trump proposed a new plan to create a maritime alliance with Israel and Iran, aiming to establish a ceasefire. The plan's details remain unclear, and its prospects for success are uncertain.

item.title: What to Know About the Stabbing Attack Against 2 Jewish Men in London
item.description: Two Jewish men were stabbed in London, and British police are investigating the attack as a possible act of terrorism. The incident is part of a rising trend of antisemitic hate crimes in the UK.
